main_text.p: volunt[?] quidam patrem ipsius Amrum regem non fuisse.
main_text.l: 15 جبلة Iabalah, Alnoomani filius, hic cum AlMon-daro Mussamai[?] f. bellum geffit.
25 النعمان AlNooman, Alharethi filius, qui & ابو كرب Abu Carb, & قطام Kotam appellatus.
26 الايهم Alıham, Iabale filius, qui & Tadmori Dominus.
30 جبلة Iabalah, f. Harethi, f. Iabale.
main_text.p: 31 جبلة Iabalah, Alihami filius, qui Regum Gassaniorum ultimus, sub Omaro Chalifa Mohammedi nomen dedit, deinde Constantinopolim petiit, ubi se Christianum professus est. De spatio quo regnarunt Gassanii in Syria dubitatur, Quidam annorum 400 fuisse aiunt, alii 600. Multi ex iis Harethi, seu Aretæ (ut Græcè & Latinè effertur) dicti, at omnes Arabum φυλάρχης Aretas appellatos, quod asserit Scaliger, ab Arabibus observatum nondum reperi.
Scholiastes in epist. Ebn Abduni paulò aliter quàm

page.notes: Arabic names in the numbered lines are copied from the scan; the Arabic script is set in the printed form and was read as clearly as possible. "volunt" at the top is uncertain (the scan looks like "voluut"). "Mussamai" in line 15 is uncertain. The catchword reads "Abul Fcda" as printed, with the printed "c" kept.
